summary.text: MIN BESTE VENN AS is a private limited company registered in Kalandseidet, founded 2019-08-21. MIN BESTE VENN AS is registered to trade in and act as agent for, among other things, garden, agricultural and zoo products, to invest in real estate and in other companies, and to engage in activities related thereto. It was previously named NYE MBV AS until 2020-09-18. Its main industry code is 47.762: retail sale of pets and pet food. The register shows 22 employees and 6 registered workplaces. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 34 107 967 NOK and the annual result was 2 891 321 NOK; operating income was down from 34 205 821 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 1 027 453 NOK in 2024 to 2 891 321 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 4 412 915 NOK in 2024 to 3 317 969 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is minbestevenn.no, which links to its Facebook, Instagram profiles. The latest news on its own website is "Ernæring for bedre pels: fôr, fiskeolje og B-vitamin" from 2026-11-02. The registered employee count went from 23 on 2026-01-14 to 22 on 2026-10-14. The register's most recent update was on 2026-10-14 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
